5. Screenshot gallery: weather × time of day × lap position

Orbit camera (az 35°, el 30°, 75 m), 1280×720 TLX, SwiftShader (no real GPU), HUD off, track frozen, JPEGs downscaled to 800 px. Weather applied with weather(w), time with setTimeOfDay(t). Eye-level and corner frames follow the grid.

Day / dry

Reference look. Flat green far-field with a hard horizon; dark wedge-shaped ridge polygons at the horizon in 0.17/0.83 (upper right). Pit-building roof fills the 0.00 orbit frame. Racing-line arrows are the default assist overlay, not scenery.

Day / overcast

Hazy: distant trees fade, white cloud-like smudges lie on the far plain, grass and road are darker than dry. Ridge wedges are still visible at the horizon.

Day / fog

Fog is the best weather response here: trees fade with depth, horizon blends, ridge wedges are hidden. Fog patches read as scattered white blobs on the far plain.

Day / wet

Whole scene darkens and goes blue-green; road is dark with a slight sheen; the far plain already has a faint teal gloss. No rain streaks.

Day / rain

Very dark and blue-cast for a daytime ToD. The far plain has a glossy sheen and reads as a lake or sea. Trees show blue specular and, at 0.67, vertical striations.

Dusk / dry

Warm low sun, golden blotchy light pools on the dirt shoulders (visible blocky texel pattern). Lamp pools appear even though def.furniture.lamp is "none".

Dusk / rain

Sun glint on the far plain (orbit 0.17 and 0.50, upper right) reads as sunlight on open water; blocky orange light pools on the shoulders as in dusk/dry; streaks barely visible.

Night / dry

Lamps and floodlight pools are present on the track edge and pit straight; shoulders show orange blocky pools; sky and far field are black with no horizon cue.

Night / rain

Darker again; glints on the pit-straight roof and car-park cars; headlight-style spots remain.

Eye-level (2.5 m on the racing line)

Orbit at the measured curvature peaks (day / dry)

6. Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

  1. Layout and corner table disagree with the brief and with the real circuit suspect. def.turns (brands_hatch.js:65) comes from the 11 strongest curvature peaks of an OSM trace, not from named corners: the brief's Druids (0.0762) lands on a 142 m sweeper that is not in the table, while 0.2977 and 0.3113 form a U-turn that has no counterpart in the real lap order (Paddock, Druids, Graham Hill, Cooper Straight, Surtees…). In the plan view the first leg after the line is a long sweep of roughly 1 km before the first tight turn. Mechanism: sparse OSM control points (≈110 for 3.9 km; the 360 m diagonal straights are one segment each, brands_hatch.js:69) smooth the Druids hairpin. Fix: hand-check turn 1→5 against a dated reference and hand over to new-track (a layout defect, not dressing); do not move K() fractions in the scenery before that.
  2. Rain makes the far terrain look like open water measured (frames). Day/rain and dusk/rain: the grass plane beyond the barrier has a mirror-like sheen with cloud-like streaks; trees appear to stand in a lake (orbit 0.17, 0.83). Mechanism: wetness specular applied to terrain, not circuit data. Fix: engine/lighting (cap terrain sheen, keep it for tarmac); route to lighting-tuner/renderer-debug, circuit-independent check needed on another circuit.
  3. Day-rain is far too dark and blue, and the eye-level rain sky stays clear blue measured. Orbit rain frames look like night; day_rain_eye_50 shows a saturated blue sky with dry-looking trees. Two views of the same weather disagree. Fix: check whether the sky dome reacts to weather() set after race() (may be capture-order, uncertain); lighting-tuner.
  4. Dark wedge ridges at the horizon measured. Dry-day orbit 0.00/0.17/0.83 and corner frames 0.0268, 0.0752 show hard-edged dark or flat olive triangles in the sky and far plain. Source: ridge() loop scenery:884–900 (len 340–420, hgt 26–34, 600–780 m out) and mountain() farHill scenery:916–930; one mountain was guard-dropped (verify warning). Fix: tint and lift ridges toward the fog colour, lengthen the base so the silhouette is not a single plane, check the dropped farHill (add a frac that clears the guard).
  5. Bowl relief is not legible measured. The road drops 28 m but orbit views show an almost flat green plane with a hard horizon; the amphitheatre brief item "bowl must read as a bowl" is not visible in any orbit frame. Probe needed: terrainYAt around frac 0.0–0.3 (suspect: terrainOuter 110 and flat terrain beyond the verge). Fix: raise banks around the infield as terrain, not props; do not flatten the road.
  6. Night/dusk light pools are blocky measured. Dusk/dry and night/dry show orange blotches with a visible texel grid on the dirt shoulders (orbit 0.17, 0.50, 0.67) and a dark-black sky/far field. Also lamp: "none" contradicts the visible lamps (brands_hatch.js:66). Fix: either set the lamp furniture to what is rendered or suppress the pools; smooth the light-pool texture (lighting-tuner / renderer).
  7. Pit-complex slabs measured. The pit/paddock complex at 0.00 is one large featureless grey roof slab and wall (orbit 0.00 and eye 0.00 fill half the frame); the orbit camera at the start line is occluded by the roof. Fix: breaks in the roof line and garage doors on the track side (scenery block 3, :499–:646) and a different default orbit offset for this circuit's survey.
  8. carPark ground fit measured (audit). carPark:113 produces 2 buried (1.30 m) and 1 unsupported (1.26 m) car and one flat coplanar pair (7.96 m² with :440). The 0.35 m gap check at :119–121 does not catch tilted slopes (the car box is 4.3 m long). Fix: also test the tail point, or raise the skip tolerance by slope.
  9. Severe clip at frac 0.943 and clustered minor clips at 0.95–0.03 measured (audit), 1.12 m frustum×frustum, 38 m³, baseline 1. Likely the start-gantry / race-control mass (scenery block 3, rows 0.960/+1). Fix: shift one volume or shrink the overlapping frustum; identify the two emitters first (not done).
  10. Footbridge columns on the track edge suspect, not captured. footbridge() puts the end columns at ±7 m (scenery:652), the same as baseHW 7. Probe with the trackside camera at 0.070/0.430 before changing.
  11. Tree species suspect: furniture.tree: "broad" and the OAK palette, but most frames show layered conifers; 358 trees are guard-dropped at build (verify warning), which thins the bowl rim.
